title: Three Januaries and One Short Door
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：home　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 home 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the builder ① built the home that no child in the village would have described, and he said the building was the whole of the January. The ② home, meaning the house itself and not the door, ran three Januarys and stayed undescribed in the book; a home, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ home in that village had the same short door beside it, and the ④ home at the far road, meaning the key they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A home, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the builder said the describing is the part that fills three Januarys.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the home was the whole of the matter, meaning the family and not the house. The ⑥ home, meaning the family and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; home, he said, is either something you build or the only word that means both a house and a family. He said the family is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ home had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short door. The ⑧ home of the whole thing, the builder wrote in February, was one village and three Januarys of describing; home, he said, is either the key at the far road or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ home I remember is the house described in the letter, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ home, my mother said in 1972, is the only house that improves by being described; every home, she said, is a family that has agreed to look like a house. She said the family was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家；住所（指村子里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 家；住所（指那个房子本身，与木门相对）
C. 固定搭配：build the home 建造一个家
D. n. 家；住所（指留给孩子们保管的那一把那一个）
E. n. 家事（抽象总称，指一处村子的家之事）
F. n. 家；住所（指书信里写到、被记下的的那一个）
G. n. 家人、归属（指一件事里人人都回却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 归属（抽象总称，指人人都回却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: built the home that no child in the village would have described

answers.why: build the home 意为“建造一个家”，1963 年那位建房人把村子里没有一位孩子肯描述的一个家做了一遍。
home 意为“家；住所”，指那个房子本身而不是木门，它经过了三个一月而在簿子上没有被描述。
home 意为“家；住所”，指村子里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一扇窄窄的木门。
home 意为“家；住所”，指最远那个路口留给孩子们保管的那一把那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
home 意为“家人、归属”，指一件事里人人都回却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份归属就是那件事的全部。
home 意为“归属”，指人人都回却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个房子，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
home 意为“家；住所”，指书信里写到、被记下的的那一个，到 1968 年这一个成了书信里的一行。
home 意为“家事”，建房人二月写道，整件事的家之事是一处村子和三个一月的描述。
home 意为“家；住所”，我记得的是书信里描述过的那一个，1970 年拆掉了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一个。
home 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，家是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的房子。
